summary: This Form 6-K filing by RELX PLC, a foreign private issuer, reports routine director/PDMR shareholdings and the grant of long-term incentive plan awards to executive directors under the 2026-2028 LTIP cycle, following shareholder approval of the 2026 remuneration policy. The awards are conditional, with no price payable on grant or vesting, which occurs after three years subject to performance conditions. The filing is a standard notification of equity compensation and does not involve any corporate control or structural event. It is the UK equivalent of a Form 8-K item 5.02 disclosure, but does not constitute a special situation.
